failure_patterns.pattern: endpoint_value_normalization: Several calls used display names, noncanonical codes, or values that did not match the endpoint's expected API representation.

rejected_edits.content: Carry unambiguous geographic context across related calls in the same task or comparison, even when the city or postal code was stated for only one requested facet. Populate corresponding market selectors on related retailer endpoints when their schemas and documented mappings support them. Keep postal-code qualifiers on endpoints that accept them, and do not add regional settings when the mapping or supported value is uncertain.
rejected_edits.target: When a request specifies a market or locale, populate directly corresponding documented parameters (such as country, store, currency, or language) when their values are documented or unambiguously implied; use canonical codes and a market-specific locale when a documented mapping establishes one.

rejected_edits.content: For search APIs with separate query and mode or attribute selectors, put the searched entity's name in the query field and use documented selectors for its artist, category, or search mode. Do not retain possessive or contextual wording as part of a title when the schema separates those concepts; use a canonical selector when the intended entity type clearly corresponds to a documented option.
rejected_edits.target: Preserve query values and their entity associations, converting them only to documented formats such as API codes, list syntax, or canonical enum spelling.
